title: Vanishing of Invariant 2-Jet Differentials and Improved Hyperbolicity Degree Bounds in Dimension Two
summary: This paper establishes new degree bounds for Kobayashi hyperbolicity in dimension two. Our main results are: -- A very generic surface in $\mathbb{P}^3$ of degree at least $17$ is Kobayashi hyperbolic. -- The complement of a very generic curve in $\mathbb{P}^2$ of degree at least $12$ is Kobayashi hyperbolic. These bounds improve the long-standing records in the field, lowering the threshold from $18$ to $17$ for surfaces (Păun) and from $14$ to $12$ for complements (Rousseau). Central to the proofs are new vanishing results for certain negatively twisted invariant $2$-jet differentials,…
